product_family: Cloud-based AI-powered music production platform with AI mastering, distribution to 150+ streaming platforms, plugins, samples, collaboration tools, online courses, and stem separation. Sub-products: LANDR Mastering Plugin, LANDR Studio, AI Stem Generator, AI Composer, Audio Enhancer, Acapella Extractor.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or Type 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 certification in privacy policy, terms of service, or support documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 certification in privacy policy, terms of service, or support documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy states 'we will provide adequate protection for the transfer of Personal Information from the EU/EEA to a third country' but no formal GDPR certification (GDPR is a regulation, not a certifiable standard). Compliance is self-declared.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable - LANDR is a music production platform, not a healthcare provider. No mention of HIPAA compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: LANDR operates a Fair Trade AI Program with explicit opt-in consent (not default). Artists must opt in to allow released tracks to be used for training AI models. Artists receive 25% of net revenues from AI model licensing. Opt-out is possible at any time (except if advance payment was accepted). LANDR claims not to use stolen, scraped, or unlicensed data. Only tracks where artists hold 100% of recording and publishing rights are eligible. For non-participating users, LANDR states: 'we shall not use Your Content for any training purposes other than as may be necessary to provide you with the Generative AI Services' (limited use). This is a transparent, consent-based, fairly-compensated approach.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region, including United States. Privacy policy states: 'store or process your Personal Information in other countries where we have facilities or have third party service providers.' No specific data center locations disclosed. Information outside user's country is subject to that country's laws.

security.name: Cloud Storage
security.value: Claims 'state-of-the-art secured cloud storage' for file and asset protection. No specific encryption standards mentioned.

security.name: Routine Testing & Maintenance
security.value: Claims 'routine testing and maintenance ensures that we're always up to industry standards.' Standard is vague and not defined.

security.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
security.value: Supports TOTP (time-based one-time password) via authenticator apps, or email-based 2FA. Available for user account protection.

security.name: Session Security
security.value: LANDR Sessions (video collaboration) allows password protection; participants must provide password to join.

security.name: Identity Verification
security.value: Uses iDenfy (third-party secure service) for identity verification to prevent unauthorized account access and fraud.

security.name: General Security Posture
security.value: Privacy policy states 'maintain appropriate physical, technical and administrative safeguards' following 'generally accepted industry standards.' Acknowledges 'no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100% secure.'

products.name: LANDR Studio
products.data_scope: Processes user audio files, metadata, account data, payment information. Retains access to uploaded tracks.
products.notes: Includes unlimited AI mastering, distribution, samples, plugins, courses, collaboration. Subscription-based.

products.name: LANDR Mastering Plugin
products.data_scope: Processes audio files within user's DAW (Digital Audio Workstation). May send audio to cloud for processing.
products.notes: Desktop plugin version of mastering service. Runs in Ableton Live, Logic Pro, etc.

products.name: Music Distribution
products.data_scope: Processes audio files, metadata, royalty data, artist information. Distributed to 150+ platforms.
products.notes: No hidden fees. Artists keep 100% of royalties. Stays live if subscription cancelled.

products.name: AI Features (Stem Generator, AI Composer, etc.)
products.data_scope: User audio/MIDI data used for generation. Covered by Fair Trade AI Program for training.
products.notes: Opt-in participation in Fair Trade AI Program for model training. 25% revenue share for participants.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription model. Free tier includes limited features. Paid tiers (LANDR Studio) offer unlimited access to mastering, distribution, samples, plugins, courses, collab tools.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region cloud storage. US and other countries. No EU-specific data residency guarantee. No DPA publicly offered.

flags: No SOC 2 certification despite handling user audio files, metadata, and payment data. No public trust center to verify compliance.
No ISO 27001 certification despite being a SaaS platform processing user content.
Security language is vague: 'generally accepted industry standards', 'state-of-the-art', 'routine testing'. No specific standards, frameworks, or audit results disclosed.
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) publicly mentioned, despite handling EU user data and claiming GDPR awareness.
Data stored in US and other countries without explicit residency controls or SLA disclosures.
Identity confusion risk: LANDR Security (landrsec.com) is a separate UK-based security consulting firm, not affiliated with LANDR Audio. Ensure not to conflate the two entities.
Fair Trade AI Program is positive (opt-in, transparent, fairly-compensated) but NOT a compliance certification. Listed as a positive practice, not a security cert.
